diagnostics.title: Ranking hook settings push refused (live strategy unchanged)
diagnostics.summary: A settings push was refused (an unknown key, a non-string `policy`, a strategy word the hook does not claim, or an invalid `expected_units` map), so the push was NACKed and the hook keeps ranking by the strategy it already had. The reason is in the line. Invalid settings are refused even at an older version; valid older versions are acknowledged without application.
diagnostics.action: Fix the named hook's settings (`policy` is one of cheapest, fastest, least_busy, usage; optional `expected_units` maps class names to finite non-negative numbers) and push the corrected configuration.
